chosenStructure.privateSnapshot: ProjectMemoryExtractionSnapshot extends exactly MemoryExtractionSnapshot and ProjectMemoryAgentContext without additional fields.

manualContractReview.method: Reasoned review of supplied contract and own source only; no executed behavior or tool-based test.
manualContractReview.enabled: Root resolution uses config plus workspaceRoot and compares to undefined.
manualContractReview.guards: Shutdown, explicit disabled extraction, root resolution/falsy root, remote workspace, then missing session/filesystem ports occur before context/snapshot work.
manualContractReview.identity: workspaceRoot remains the root identity; workingDirectory is used only as a captured loop field.
manualContractReview.capture: Context capture precedes reading latestConversationMessageId; falsy boundary returns after capture and before store or scheduler calls.
manualContractReview.storeOrder: messages({sessionID: runtime.sessionId}) starts first, getSession(runtime.sessionId) second, before Promise.all; synchronous throws propagate.
manualContractReview.branch: Opaque active-branch selector receives all four required revert fields; native findIndex uses the captured boundary; missing boundary throws the exact supplied error.
manualContractReview.boundedSnapshot: Spread captured context then boundary and active.slice(0, boundaryIndex + 1); no newer messages, mutation, or deep clone.
manualContractReview.scheduler: Nullish initialization uses the opaque existing scheduler; schedule receives the snapshot promise immediately as a receiver call; promise failures remain scheduler concerns.
manualContractReview.telemetry: Detached scope precedes telemetry.run; factory and run calls have no wrapping try; run preserves its receiver.
manualContractReview.scanAndBuild: Manifest scan uses the supplied filesystem port, snapshot root, and abort signal; post-scan cancellation precedes prompt, provider messages, then executor creation.
manualContractReview.loop: Opaque loop receives exactly the supplied ordered fields and maxTurns 5; executor.execute retains its receiver and maps options.abortSignal to signal plus snapshot traceContext.
manualContractReview.successAndFailure: finishCompleted is inside try; aborted signal or DOMException AbortError causes cancellation; ordinary Error name AbortError is not specially recognized; other failures call finishFailed(execute, internal, error).
manualContractReview.callbackThrows: Finish callbacks inside try can enter catch; catch callbacks may escape; no extra logging or error remapping.
manualContractReview.drain: Captured scheduler once; absent returns; null waits directly without timer; otherwise drain is called first in the race, timer is unrefed optionally, and truthy timer cleared in finally; errors propagate.
manualContractReview.noAddedFeatures: No new root/permission/model checks, queue/cursor/abort owner, writable targets/tools, shutdown call, timeout sanitation, polling, events, or logs.
